body: Bot now calls 'emily observe' on three events: (1) session start on launch, (2) connected on PacketWelcome with clientID/sceneID, (3) kill confirmed on PacketImpact hit_entity=1 with total kill count and seq. Non-blocking goroutine exec. Rate-limited: min 15s between observations to prevent kill-streak spam. -no-report flag disables all reporting.
title: S38-03: emily-bot kill/event reporting to Emily Prime
